title: SAC trust() for a trustor who is not the transaction source creates a trustline
pattern: alice submits, carol is the trustor: carol authorizes with address credentials and a nonce. The trustline is carol's; nothing names it but the created entry. wallet-backend#731 dropped such trustlines.

hazards.placement: InvokeHostFunction trust() with address credentials creates the trustor's trustline

facts.says: A trustline for carol is created.
carol authorizes with address credentials and nonce 7310001.
